sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) Without prejudice to subarticle (2), the Chief Justice shall have no authority over any matter concerning the structure and day-to-day administration of courts established under the Constitution of Zanzibar or any law of Tanzania Zanzibar. (2) The Chief Justice shall from time to time consult the Chief Justice of Zanzibar concerning the general administration of the Court of Appeal and also concerning the appointment of Justices of Appeal.
vifungu: (1) Without prejudice to subarticle (2), the Chief Justice shall have no authority over any matter concerning the structure and day-to-day administration of courts established under the Constitution of Zanzibar or any law of Tanzania Zanzibar.
